target_customer: Small and mid sized installers of heat pumps, solar, wallboxes and batteries in Germany
problem: Installers lose dozens of hours per project to paper processes and disconnected CRM, ERP, email and planning tools.

founders.name: Etienne-Noel Krause
founders.background_notes: Nearly four years in the HVAC industry per YC page.

competitors.name: GeoT*Sol
competitors.what: Heat pump and solar planning software

technical_complexity.rationale: Heat load calculation, LiDAR scanning and CRM workflows are standard engineering with computer vision on top.

defensibility.rationale: Replacing an installer's whole workflow creates switching costs, though planning tools from manufacturers existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Manufacturers offer their own planning tools; no source shows an acquisition or copy of autarc.

market_need_then: Heat pump demand in Germany rose with the 2023 and 2024 heating law debate; the YC launch post claims 380 customers and seven figure ARR.

brand_strength.rationale: Name resembles autarch and the solar company Autarco, which caused search confusion; no brand press was found.

outcome_analysis: autarc started in 2023 as a heat pump planning tool, raised a single digit million pre-seed in December 2023 and reportedly a seed in early 2025, and by 2025 claimed 380 customers and seven figure ARR. Success rests on founder insight in HVAC and strong regulatory driven demand.
notes: A seed of $8.9M in February 2025 appears only in Seedtable and database aggregators (Caplight calls it Series A), so it is unverified and not recorded as a round. Totals range from $8.8M to $9.95M across databases. The YC page claims 15 employees while the directory lists 30.
